name: regexp
summary: Small bounded regular-expression engine for Ada and SPARK-compatible code.

build.tests: cd tests && alr exec -- gprbuild -P tests.gpr && ./bin/tests

requires: clean Git worktree after intended changes are committed

important_semantics: Compile patterns before matching.
Only use Compile_Result.Expression when Status is Compile_Ok.
Match offsets are one-based and relative to Text'First.
String slices report offsets relative to the slice.
Capture ranges are one-based and relative to Text'First.
Capture_Index maps named captures to numbered capture slots.
Capture_Name copies a numbered capture's name into a caller-supplied output buffer.
Unmatched optional captures report First = 0 and Last = 0.
Captures inside lookahead and lookbehind assertions are assertion-local and not exported.
Lookbehind assertions must be fixed-width.
Inline option groups are scoped to the group body.
Backreferences must refer to captures declared earlier in the pattern.
Possessive quantifiers and atomic groups commit to their longest internal match.
Atomic subpatterns currently reject captures and backreferences.
Zero-length matches report Last less than First.
Find_All advances automatically after zero-length matches.
Find_All_Overlapping advances one character after each previous match start.
Stream_Cursor retains bounded data so matches can span chunks.
Stream matches report one-based offsets from the beginning of the stream.
Start_Stream can select a smaller per-cursor retained-buffer limit.
Replacement and split APIs use caller-supplied output buffers.
Dot_Matches_Newline is disabled by default.
Multiline_Anchors is disabled by default.
Compile_Literal escapes all regexp metacharacters.
Compile_Literal_Set compiles caller-selected ranges as an escaped literal alternation.
Compile_Literal_Word_Set compiles caller-selected word ranges as a bounded whole-word alternation.
Compile_Anchored, Compile_Whole_Word, and Compile_Line wrap raw patterns for common matching modes.
Compile_Literal_Anchored, Compile_Literal_Whole_Word, and Compile_Literal_Line wrap escaped literal text.
Supports_Syntax queries supported Syntax_Feature families.
Syntax_Feature_Image and Supported_Syntax expose printable supported syntax inventories.
Escape_Literal returns escaped literal text for embedding in larger patterns.
Escape_Replacement returns replacement text that is inserted literally.
Append_Literal and Append_Literal_Alternative escape user-supplied text into a caller buffer.
Append_Class_Literal and Append_Class_Range build escaped character-class members.
Build_Literal_Alternation and Build_Literal_Word_Alternation build escaped patterns from text ranges.
Is_Literal, Is_Anchored, Is_Whole_Line, Needs_Backtracking, Can_Stream_Safely, and Recommended_Strategy classify expressions.
Summary, Source_Kind, Copy_Source_Pattern, and Lint expose bounded expression metadata and warnings.
Compile_Diagnostic and Replacement_Diagnostic expose structured diagnostic records.
Find_From_Planned uses a deterministic required-prefix skip when available.
Find_From_Planned_With_Captures combines prefix planning with capture output.
Line_Column, Match_Line_Range, Match_Context, and Find_First_Line convert matches into source ranges.
Match_Length, Contains_Offset, Before_Match, and After_Match provide match range helpers.
Find_All_Lines collects line ranges for all non-overlapping matches.
Find_All_Summary counts matches and records first/last matches without storing every match.
Find_All_Line_Summary adds first/last source positions and containing line ranges.
Find_All_With_Captures collects match ranges and capture ranges in one bounded call.
Find_All_Overlapping_With_Captures collects overlapping match and capture ranges.
Find_First_Of, Find_From_Of, and Tokenize support bounded multi-pattern search.
Tokenize_With_Kinds, Find_First_Of_With_Captures, Find_From_Of_With_Captures, and Tokenize_With_Captures add explicit token kinds and captures.
Copy_Range, Copy_Before, Copy_After, Copy_Match_Line, Copy_Capture, and Copy_Named_Capture copy ranges.
Named_Captures inventories capture indexes that have names.
Named_Capture_Range maps a capture name directly to a range.
Next_With_Captures iterates matches and captures without storing every match.
Next_Captured and Next_Line_Captured return record-oriented cursor results.
Start_Token_Stream and Feed_Tokens provide bounded chunked tokenization.
Feed_With_Captures returns stream-relative capture ranges for stream matches.
Has_Captures, Uses_Anchors, May_Match_Empty, Required_Prefix, and Features inspect compiled expressions.
Validate_Policy rejects compiled expressions with policy-disallowed features.
Validate_Policy_Detail reports the first disallowed Policy_Feature.
Literal_Search_Policy, Editor_Search_Policy, No_Backtracking_Features_Policy, Safe_User_Search_Policy, Streaming_Search_Policy, and Editor_Replace_Policy are policy presets.
Replace_First_Count and Replace_All_Count report the number of replacements made.
Replace_First_Size and Replace_All_Size dry-run replacement expansion and report required output length.
Validate_Replacement checks replacement syntax and capture references before writing output.
Validate_Replacement_Detail adds error offset, capture index, and named-reference range diagnostics.
Replacement_References inventories valid replacement capture references.
Replacement_Summary reports replacement feature flags and validation detail.
Required_First_Output_Length, Required_All_Output_Length, and Replacement_Fits wrap replacement sizing.
Plan_Replacement previews copied and replaced source ranges.
Replacement_Edit reports required expanded length for each planned edit.
Replace_All_Lines and Split_Lines provide line-oriented planning helpers.
Is_Syntax_Error, Is_Unsupported, and Is_Limit_Error classify statuses for diagnostics.
Explain and the Format_*_Diagnostic helpers write bounded diagnostic text into caller buffers.
Explain_Nodes exposes structured compiled-node summaries.
Benchmark_Pattern and Benchmark_Text expose built-in smoke corpus cases.
Benchmark_Summary runs built-in smoke corpus cases, and token-name helpers support bounded diagnostics.
Replacement strings expand \0, \1 through \9, \k<name>, and \\.
Replacement strings support case escapes \U...\E, \L...\E, \u, and \l.
Copy_Match copies a successful match into a caller-supplied output buffer.
Default matching is ASCII case-insensitive.
UTF_8_Mode validates input and invalid UTF-8 returns No_Match.
Validate_UTF_8 returns a UTF_8_Validation_Result with a one-based error offset.
Fingerprint and Metadata provide bounded cache-key metadata for compiled patterns.
Build_Character_Class finalizes escaped character-class members.
Supported_Syntax_Detail returns structured support notes and examples.
Plan_Replacement_Detail returns replacement references, output maps, and aggregate planning counts.
Feed_Tokens_Detail returns Token_Stream_Status values for chunked tokenization.
Feed_Tokens_With_Captures returns capture ranges for chunked tokenization.
Max_Steps bounds matching work.
